description: This file defines the ArrayArgumentHelper class, which provides utility methods for handling array arguments in spreadsheet calculations, including initialization, vector detection, and argument analysis.

classes.name: ArrayArgumentHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing array arguments in spreadsheet formulas, including detection of vector and matrix arguments, flattening single-cell arrays, and argument initialization.

methods.name: initialise
methods.description: Initializes the helper with given array arguments, setting internal state and validating the number of array arguments.

methods.name: hasArrayArgument
methods.description: Checks if there are any array arguments present.

methods.name: getFirstArrayArgumentNumber
methods.description: Returns the index (1-based) of the first array argument, or 0 if none.

methods.name: getSingleRowVector
methods.description: Returns the index of a single row vector argument if exactly one exists, otherwise null.

methods.name: getSingleColumnVector
methods.description: Returns the index of a single column vector argument if exactly one exists, otherwise null.

methods.name: getMatrixPair
methods.description: Returns a pair of indices representing a matrix argument if found.

methods.name: isVector
methods.description: Determines if an argument is a vector (row or column).

methods.name: isRowVector
methods.description: Checks if an argument is a row vector.

methods.name: isColumnVector
methods.description: Checks if an argument is a column vector.

methods.name: rowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows of a given argument.

methods.name: columnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns of a given argument.
